additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
60 mana, 0.25 mana regeneration and 0.5% flat base magic resistance.
5 main attack damage to all / / heroes.
10.5 main attack damage to universal heroes.
description: Said to have belonged to a goddess, today it retains much of its former power.
trivia: The name "Shiva" is a reference to the Shiva of the Final Fantasy series, an elemental summon with the power of ice.
tips: Arctic Blast's effect hits every enemy once within its radius, even after its edge has expanded past the target. Because of its slow expansion time (taking about 2 seconds to reach max radius), it can be thought of as a moving area effect, centered on the hero.

The spell amplification combined with the slow on Arctic Blast means enemies caught become highly vulnerable. Consider initiating the fight with it while your team's spells are all at the ready for a strong start to any teamfight.
Good against heroes and creeps with low attack speed, causing them to attack even slower.

notes: The wave extends at a speed of 400 to a max size of 825.
The Arctic Blast follows its caster.
Multiple instances of Freezing Aura do not stack.
AoE bonuses from multiple Chasm Stones or its upgrades do not stack.
